courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：重組晶圓、晶粒位移與 RDL 互連。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Reconstituted wafers, die shift and RDL interconnect. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 扇出型面板級封裝
related.why: 共享重組、模封與 RDL 的互動
related.whyEn: Shares reconstitution, molding and RDL interactions
related.transfer: 共享重組、模封與 RDL 的互動
related.transferEn: Shares reconstitution, molding and RDL interactions
related.difference: 面板尺度、邊界和曝光拼接不同於圓晶圓
related.differenceEn: Panel scale, boundaries and stitching differ from round wafers
practice: 以「Chip-first 與 chip-last」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use chip-first and chip-last to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points.
Using "Map material/test handoffs for both routes.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍
related.why: 晶粒位移和模封表面是 RDL 對位輸入
related.whyEn: Die shift and mold surfaces are RDL alignment inputs

related.difference: 扇出整合還包括來料良品、支撐與板級可靠度
related.differenceEn: Fan-out additionally includes die screening, support and board reliability
practice: 以「重組翹曲」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「晶粒與模封材料分布形成非均勻剛性和曲率。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「比較熱態與室溫全片形狀。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use reconstituted warpage to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Die/mold distribution creates nonuniform stiffness and curvature.
Using "Compare hot and room-temperature wafer shapes.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.
